S.FORM: alang Blhuy ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 11 buwan, 43 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 86% kyan ku 37 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 14% kyan ku 6 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 84%, Bunun 2%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. tay 'llaw na Blhuy2 hya' ga rgyax krahu' tay 'zil na Blhuy2 hya' ga Sincyuk. tay mkyahu' na Blhuy2 hya' ga Sincyuk. tay mkraya' na Blhuy2 hya' ga Taipei.
S.PHON: alaŋ βlħuj ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * taj ʔllaw na βlħuj* ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na βlħuj* ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]juk taj mkjaħuʔ na βlħuj* ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]juk taj mkrajaʔ na βlħuj* ħjaʔ ɣa taipei
